name: cursor-bridge
description: Evidence-backed Cursor Context Engine (CLI-first over isolated ACP) and optional bounded Cursor Agent execution.

interface.shortDescription: CLI-first evidence-backed CCE search and optional bounded cursor_do execution.
interface.longDescription: Cursor Bridge routes Cursor Context Engine (CCE) searches through Cursor Agent CLI by default (read-only Ask mode over persistent isolated ACP with preflight checks and explicit model selection), and retains Cursor IDE/Agents over CDP as an explicit fallback source for CCE and cursor_do.
